# openwrt_uhttpd (Resource)

The uhttpd web server instance serving LuCI and /ubus (`config uhttpd`). Changes here can cut the provider off; rollback protects against that.

Manages a `uhttpd` section in `/etc/config/uhttpd`. This section normally exists on a stock router: creating the resource adopts it (renaming an anonymous section to `section`), and destroying the resource only removes it from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `cert` (String) TLS certificate file. (UCI option `cert`.)
- `cgi_prefix` (String) CGI prefix. (UCI option `cgi_prefix`.)
- `error_page` (String) Error page handler. (UCI option `error_page`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `home` (String) Document root. (UCI option `home`.)
- `http_keepalive` (Number) HTTP keepalive timeout. (UCI option `http_keepalive`.)
- `index_page` (List of String) Index pages. (UCI option `index_page`.)
- `key` (String) TLS private key file (a path, not the key). (UCI option `key`.)
- `listen_http` (List of String) HTTP listen addresses. (UCI option `listen_http`.)
- `listen_https` (List of String) HTTPS listen addresses. (UCI option `listen_https`.)
- `lua_prefix` (List of String) Lua handler prefixes. (UCI option `lua_prefix`.)
- `max_connections` (Number) Maximum concurrent connections. (UCI option `max_connections`.)
- `max_requests` (Number) Maximum concurrent requests. (UCI option `max_requests`.)
- `network_timeout` (Number) Network timeout in seconds. (UCI option `network_timeout`.)
- `no_dirlists` (Boolean) Disable directory listings. (UCI option `no_dirlists`.)
- `redirect_https` (Boolean) Redirect HTTP to HTTPS. (UCI option `redirect_https`.)
- `rfc1918_filter` (Boolean) Reject requests from public IPs to private addresses. (UCI option `rfc1918_filter`.)
- `script_timeout` (Number) Script timeout in seconds. (UCI option `script_timeout`.)
- `tcp_keepalive` (Boolean) Enable TCP keepalive. (UCI option `tcp_keepalive`.)
- `ubus_cors` (Boolean) Enable CORS for ubus. (UCI option `ubus_cors`.)
- `ubus_prefix` (String) ubus JSON-RPC prefix (the provider needs this, normally `/ubus`). (UCI option `ubus_prefix`.)
- `ucode_prefix` (List of String) ucode handler prefixes. (UCI option `ucode_prefix`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
